title: High-Level Design

node_notes.usart2: USART2 is the debug UART using PA2 for TX and PA3 for RX at 115200 baud. firmware/platforms/stm32/motor_platform.c configures the pins with GPIO_AF7_USART2 and initializes HAL_UART.
node_notes.motor_mode: PC8 selects the three-input PWM mode and is driven low by motor_platform_pwm_mode. The binding and MODE-low behavior are defined in app_config.h and motor_platform.c.
node_notes.motor_enable_u: PB13 enables the U phase output when the motor is enabled and is cleared on shutdown. motor_platform.c writes APP_MOTOR_EN_U_PIN through HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.user_led: PA5 is the NUCLEO-G431RB active-high user LED and is asserted during application startup. app_config.h binds APP_LED_GPIO_PORT and APP_LED_GPIO_PIN, while motor_platform_led_on calls HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.tim1_pwm: TIM1 generates the three motor PWM channels at PA8, PA9, and PA10. firmware/platforms/stm32/motor_platform.c configures TIM1 channels 1 through 3 with APP_MOTOR_PWM_PERIOD_TICKS equal to 4000.
node_notes.motor_enable_w: PB15 enables the W phase output when the motor is enabled and is cleared on shutdown. motor_platform.c writes APP_MOTOR_EN_W_PIN through HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.motor_enable_v: PB14 enables the V phase output when the motor is enabled and is cleared on shutdown. motor_platform.c writes APP_MOTOR_EN_V_PIN through HAL_GPIO_WritePin.
node_notes.uart_log: The console sink receives LOGI and LOGE output through printf and the _write retarget. logger.h defines the macros and motor_platform.c sends the resulting bytes with HAL_UART_Transmit.
node_notes.motor_fault: PB12 is configured as a pulled-up input and is interpreted as an active-low fault. motor_platform.c reads it with HAL_GPIO_ReadPin through the EN_FAULT callback used by safety_platform.
node_notes.app_start: This module orchestrates LED startup, safety initialization, motor initialization, the boot delay, fault checks, sinusoidal control, and shutdown. firmware/app/app.c provides the app_start implementation and calls the platform, sequence, sine, and logging APIs.
node_notes.safety_platform: This layer initializes the independent watchdog, reads the motor fault input, latches faults, and disables the motor. firmware/platforms/stm32/safety_platform.c implements these operations through HAL_IWDG and motor_platform APIs.
node_notes.main_entry: This is the STM32 reset-side entry that performs HAL startup and calls app_start. The evidence is Core/Src/main.c, where HAL_Init and app_start are used before the empty infinite loop.
node_notes.motor_stby: PC9 is the motor standby control and is driven by HAL_GPIO_WritePin during initialization, enable, and disable operations. The binding is APP_MOTOR_STBY_PORT and APP_MOTOR_STBY_PIN in firmware/configs/app_config.h.
node_notes.sine_control: This module stores frequency, amplitude, and phase and produces three sinusoidal duty values. firmware/modules/sine_control/sine_control.c generates U, V, and W outputs with 120-degree phase offsets.
node_notes.motor_platform: This is the STM32 HAL adapter for GPIO, TIM1 PWM, USART2, and the portable motor driver. firmware/platforms/stm32/motor_platform.c contains HAL_GPIO_Init, HAL_TIM_PWM_Init, HAL_TIM_PWM_Start, HAL_GPIO_ReadPin, and HAL_UART_Transmit usage.
node_notes.motor_sequence: This module tracks boot delay, startup ramp, hold, shutdown ramp, and stopped states. firmware/modules/motor_sequence/motor_sequence.c advances elapsed_ms using the configured 10 ms control period.
node_notes.ihm16m1_driver: This portable driver owns the STSPIN830/X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 interface contract and invokes platform callbacks for PWM, standby, and fault. firmware/drivers/x_nucleo_ihm16m1/x_nucleo_ihm16m1.c implements x_nucleo_ihm16m1_init, x_nucleo_ihm16m1_drive_motor, and x_nucleo_ihm16m1_read_fault.
